Hi Roy,

Thank you for the full write-up, the fuse photos, the video and the serial label. That's everything we need. A miner with no fans, no LEDs and no display, even with a different power supply and the spare fuse fitted, is now with our hardware team for review.

They will look at your evidence and decide the next step for your Nexus L1. That includes whether it goes through a warranty return. The team is offline today. They pick this up tomorrow from 10am Eastern, and their answer will come to you in this email thread.

One question would help them: has the L1 always run on its factory settings, or was it ever overclocked or tuned by hand?

If you'd like to talk it through sooner, our technical lead JD is active on our Discord: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf (post in the server and mention @nullhashrate).

Best regards,
Sarah

---

**Notes for the team (not part of the email):**
- **Customer check:** The email and order number match Shop····, which ships to (address hidden). The L1 was delivered on June 27. No returns are on file.
- **Flag:** I flagged it as technical so JD or Georges can decide on the RMA. Tech support hasn't confirmed a fault, so I promised no return, label or replacement.
- **History:** Roy has spent months chasing EU power cords on this same order, so he may be short on patience.

Have you seen this??

Sent from my iPhone

Best regards,

Hi Roy,

Thank you, I've noted option 1: a free Hammer DC06 to replace your Nexus L1.

Your return reference is Shop····. Please write it clearly on the outside of the box when you send the L1 back. The prepaid PostNL label will come to you, as promised.

To be upfront with you, the DC06 isn't on our shelf in Europe right now. A colleague is arranging your unit and will confirm in this email thread when it ships.

Best regards,
Sarah

---

**Notes for the team (not part of the email):**
- **Status:** The RMA is approved (the order is tagged `rma-approved`). Return Shop···· is open and waiting for the unit, PostNL tracking ····. The dispute check came back clear.
- **Replacement not created:** I didn't create the DC06 replacement. The stock check shows 0 units on hand for the Netherlands and no confirmed date, so it can't be offered or reserved yet. I flagged it as "other" so you can decide how to supply the DC06 you offered him and when it ships.
- **Label:** I don't have a link for the return label, so I didn't send one. I only repeated your message that the PostNL label is coming. Please make sure it reaches him.
- **Price:** The DC06 lists at $379.99 against the $350 he paid for the L1. That's under 10% more, but since you offered it free there should be nothing to charge him.
